rationale: The plan correctly specifies ~ batch + condition with control as reference and an explicit treated_vs_control contrast, matching the balanced two-batch design, and it explicitly forbids pre-normalizing counts, letting DESeq2 size factors handle it. QC is present (PCA colored by batch and condition, library size/dispersion checks) but lacks an explicit outlier/shallow-sample policy. The low-count filter (sum<10) is reasonable and stated as minimal. A major gap is the absence of log2FC shrinkage (e.g., apeglm/lfcShrink) despite BH/independent filtering being handled correctly. Enrichment was not strictly warranted by the question but is included with a defined universe, named/versioned GMT, and stated GSEA ranking metric, so it is well-specified even if arguably out of scope. The report states thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats (n=6 power) but omits explicit software version numbers.
